advisory.heading: When you select the words and the tone
advisory.text: The base list contains only terms and meanings that we wrote. It has no table that gives approved words for words that are not approved.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/technical-terms.md line 13, the file tells that the base list has no table that gives approved words for words that are not approved, but lines 20 and 43 to 182 give tables with a "Do not use" column next to each approved term.
advisory.correction: The base list contains only terms and meanings that we wrote. It is not the ASD-STE100 dictionary. The "Do not use" column gives only examples of words that the base list does not permit.
